resources.string: ClosePaw is controlling the screen — please don\'t touch
The virtual display is unavailable, so ClosePaw is running on your main screen. Tap Stop to end it.
ClosePaw is working in the background — you can keep using your phone
Don\'t open the app ClosePaw is operating until it finishes.
You opened %1$s, which ClosePaw was using. Tap Resume when you\'re done with it, or Stop.
Tap Resume to continue, or Stop.
ClosePaw can\'t run the Shelly task
Enable ClosePaw\'s accessibility service, then try again.
Finish ClosePaw setup first. Tap to open ClosePaw.
ClosePaw needs the \"display over other apps\" permission. Tap to open ClosePaw.
Sign in or add an API key for the selected model. Tap to open ClosePaw.
Another task is running. Stop it or wait, then ask Shelly again.
Shizuku isn\'t running — task not started
Background mode needs Shizuku. Start Shizuku and ask again, or tap to run it in the foreground (ClosePaw will take over the screen).
Allow Shelly to control the main screen
When the virtual display (Shizuku) is unavailable, Shelly may run tasks on your main screen. ClosePaw will take over the screen.
Shelly tasks only run in the background on the virtual display; without Shizuku they are refused.
